name: CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd. provides mobile communication network equipment and mobile communication technology services to telecom operators in China and internationally. The company offers 8-ports, 12-ports, 16-ports, and 20-ports antenna; RAN products, such as AAU, all in one, BBU, mRRU, pRRU, and RRU series; and indoor and outdoor CPE series. It also provides operation solutions comprising fixed wireless access and IBS; enterprise solutions, including smart grid and mining, as well as smart city rail; and wireless network service, digitization and intelligent service, network construction and optimization, digital talent empowerment, and network O and M solutions. CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Wuhan, China.
